summary: Format and lint staged changes, enforce Conventional Commits and run project tests before pushing through local Git hooks.
description: Check contributions locally with lefthook. Pre-commit formats and lints staged files, commit-msg checks Conventional Commits, and pre-push runs the project's tests. Installation is wired into project setup and skipped in CI. The instructions reuse each stack's commands and require proving both rejected and valid commit subjects. Hosted checks still belong in CI.
seoDescription: Local lefthook checks for staged formatting and linting, Conventional Commits and project tests before push, wired into setup.

projectExamples.title: Consistent Go contributions
projectExamples.description: Run formatting and the Go project's checks before commits and pushes. Validate commit subjects for a useful release history.

projectExamples.title: Frontend and backend commit checks
projectExamples.description: Format staged files by language area and run the Python and React project's declared checks before pushing.

plain.whatItIs: Local Git checks that format and lint the files you are about to commit, check commit messages, and run tests before you push.
goodAt: Catching formatting and code-quality problems before each commit
Rejecting commit messages that lack a standard type prefix, such as fix or feat
Running the project's tests before code is pushed to a shared copy
notGoodAt: Checks on the shared copy after a push; the GitHub Actions add-on does that.

requests: clean up staged files and restage the fixes when I commit

run our tests automatically before I push
install contribution checks automatically when someone sets up a fresh clone
